rules.phase_model:
(VERIFIED by disassembly): no AI node reads the boss's HP, so there are no mid-fight HP-threshold
phases inside one class row. A multi-phase boss is a chain of class rows/spawns: when a phase's HP reaches 0 the
death cutscene runs and spawns (or converts a cutscene actor into) the next spawn def.
rules.hit_reactions: Fighter bosses (ai 21/29/80/98/129/138) use on-hit state 18: damage, then attack id 9 -> stun 128+32 f (state 20, with knockback 16), id 15 -> stun 256+64 f (state 19), else knockback: wall behind -> state 16 KnockbackInvulnerable(48) = unhittable until the hurt anim ends; open ground -> state 17 Knockback(32). Cell Nonperfect/Perfect (ai 116/148) use the twin handler 113 (Knockback 24 / KnockbackInvulnerable 40). VERIFIED(disasm).
rules.invulnerability: Bosses have no scripted invulnerable windows inside a fight; they are unhittable only during KnockbackInvulnerable (wall case) and while not spawned/in cutscenes. VERIFIED(disasm).
rules.heals: Android 19/20 (ai 29): any energy attack is absorbed: no damage, heal 20% of raw damage (VERIFIED in emulator). Cell drain grab heals Cell by the damage it deals (VERIFIED(disasm); heal capped at max HP).
rules.teleports: No teleport node exists in the AI node set; bosses move only via Chase/Flee/Align/BackAway nodes (and cutscene actors).
rules.summons: Cell Juniors are not summoned by the AI: they are three separate spawn defs (map 325 objects 8, 9, 10) activated one at a time by the previous fight's death cutscene, each followed by an active-character switch.
